mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS "userId", user_nm AS "userName" FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT r.role_id AS "roleId", r.role_nm AS "roleName" FROM tb_sy_user_role ur JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.role_nm, r.role_id

WITH affiliations AS ( SELECT s.part_id FROM tb_bs_part_std s WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{userId} AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_bs_part_std newer WHERE newer.part_id=s.part_id AND newer.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (newer.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR newer.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) AND newer.aply_bgn_ym > s.aply_bgn_ym ) UNION SELECT s.part_id FROM tb_sy_user_scope s WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' UNION SELECT pp.part_id FROM tb_sy_user_scope s JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=s.proj_id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.part_id FROM tb_pj_proj_part h WHERE h.proj_id=p.proj_id AND h.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1 ) pp ON true WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND p.proj_stat_cd NOT IN ('END','LOSE') ) SELECT p.part_id AS "partId", p.part_nm AS "partName" FROM tb_bs_part p JOIN affiliations a ON a.part_id=p.part_id ORDER BY p.part_nm, p.part_id
